pass_rule: PASS only if all five frozen nonhistorical regimes pass with zero historical/network reads, byte-identical qualification/control manifests for identical inputs, exact manifest-to-physical accounting, exactly one terminal trace per manifest unit, and FULL_SUPPORT reproduces 31008 validation fits, 11904 economic fits, and 40 NNLS solves.
failure_rule: Any violation is QUALIFICATION_FAIL. Semantic-preserving execution-assurance engineering may be modified and requalified under 0068, but no historical measurement is allowed under this research ID.
anti_rescue: Do not change scientific semantics, eligibility rules, estimator/model grids, horizons, controllers, bootstrap/PBO, or classification gates to make qualification pass.
